title: Kern
description: One word set huge in Bricolage Grotesque, every letter a body tied to its neighbours by springs at the font's true kerning. Pull a letter and the line stretches like a ribbon, let go and it re-kerns itself, with the spacing values live underneath.
intent: Make spacing physical: the optically correct spacing (the font's kerning plus the house tracking law) is the rest length of a spring chain, so stretching, morphing weight and width, and retyping all resolve back to perfectly set type.
sources: herb reference board: b091f70f Pinterest promo (giant grotesk, type as the subject)
